scope.task: regular eighth pass first-party YC evidence hunt

policy.acceptedOnly: Native first-party posts, videos, comments, repos, releases, issues, discussions, Product Hunt launches, or Launch YC launches with verifiable URLs and visible metrics.
policy.rejected: Profiles, search pages, third-party reposts, YC org posts, unavailable repos, inferred metrics, blocked pages without visible metrics, and duplicates already present in targeted evidence, graph files, or prior source-hunt outputs.

searches.queryOrCommand: jq counts over public/graph/s2026.json public/graph/s26.json public/graph/a16zsr006.json and targeted evidence source URL extraction
searches.result: Scoped three graph batches: S2026 197 companies/2292 evidence, S26 83 companies/409 evidence, A16ZSR006 59 companies/140 evidence. Dedupe set included targeted-evidence-current, graph JSON, and prior outputs/source-hunt JSON.
Accepted Molagri founder post, two Operon founder posts, and Codag founder YC announcement. OpenRelay surfaced profiles/related pages only.
Accepted Rex, Rindler, and Petrarch founder posts plus Rindler/Petrarch Launch YC pages. Perceptron ML surfaced no qualifying first-party post.
Accepted Risklytics founder post. TrustAI surfaced a YC-org post and was rejected; Salem Robotics and Torus did not produce qualifying first-party native posts in the checked results.

searches.queryOrCommand: "AICE" "YC P26" "LinkedIn"; "Arctic Health" "YC P26" "LinkedIn"; "Arzana" "YC P26" "LinkedIn"; "CentralComs" "YC P26" "LinkedIn"; follow-up quote searches for Arzana and Arctic Health post text
searches.result: Accepted William Alexander's Arzana founder post and Arctic Health's official company post. CentralComs and one Arctic Health candidate were YC-org posts and rejected.
Accepted Acceler8 seed-round founder post. Acceler8 Demo Day post was rejected as a prior-source duplicate; other checked a16z names produced profiles, third-party pages, or no qualifying post.

searches.queryOrCommand: "Codag" "YC S26" site:x.com; "Molagri" "YC S26" site:x.com; "Operon" "YC S26" site:x.com; "Risklytics" "YC S26" site:x.com; Launch YC related X searches for Rindler and Petrarch
searches.result: No accepted X statuses. Results were profiles, third-party posts, or lacked verifiable native status metrics tied to company/founder authorship.

searches.queryOrCommand: "Codag" "Product Hunt"; "Molagri" "Product Hunt"; "Rindler" "Product Hunt"; "Petrarch" "Product Hunt"; followed founder LinkedIn comment to Product Hunt
searches.result: Accepted Codag Product Hunt native launch page. Third-party Product Hunt mirrors/digests were rejected. Other checked names produced no native first-party Product Hunt launch with visible metrics.

searches.queryOrCommand: GitHub REST API checks for founder/company-linked repos, especially Codag and OpenRelay
searches.result: Accepted Codag canonical GitHub repo after the founder-linked URL redirected to codag-megalith/codag-visualizer with visible stars/forks/issues. Rejected OpenRelay exact local URL because it returned unavailable through the GitHub API.

searches.queryOrCommand: Native Reddit URL checks for Codag Product Hunt/Anthropic surfaced results plus unauthenticated Reddit searches for Codag, Molagri, Operon, Risklytics, Rindler, Petrarch, Rex, Arzana, Acceler8, and Arctic Health
searches.result: No accepted Reddit evidence. One Codag page was reachable but lacked visible metrics and independently matched founder authorship; API/search checks were blocked with HTTP 403.

searches.result: No accepted HN evidence; checked target-name searches returned empty or non-qualifying results.

searches.result: No accepted Instagram/TikTok evidence. Visible results were third-party/event pages, profile/search pages, or blocked/unusable pages without verified first-party metrics.

searches.queryOrCommand: Attempted high-coverage DuckDuckGo/r.jina web sweep over repo company names and evidence terms
searches.result: Initial single-query retrieval worked, but the broad concurrent sweep hit HTTP 429 rate limits. Manual targeted follow-up searches were used for accepted/rejected candidates above.

notes: All accepted entries are first-party company/founder/company-account native URLs with visible metrics and exact URLs.

LinkedIn evidence was accepted only when public post pages exposed post-level metrics. Most accepted LinkedIn pages exposed SocialMediaPosting JSON-LD with datePublished, headline/body, author, interactionStatistic, commentCount, and follower counts.

Petrarch's LinkedIn post was accepted with a medium attribution caveat: the public JSON-LD omitted author/body, but the URL slug matches the YC-listed founder Sudhish Swain and the page exposed date/headline/metrics.

Launch YC evidence was treated as native first-party YC launch evidence because the pages expose launch ids, company names, company batch fields, creator users, creation timestamps, and vote_count metrics.
Product Hunt Codag was accepted only after direct native-page verification; third-party mirrors and daily digests were rejected even when they repeated Product Hunt metrics.
GitHub repo evidence was accepted only for a directly linked/canonical repo with visible API metrics. Unavailable exact repos and inferred sibling repos were rejected.
No app/source JSON files were edited.
